text:
maria: Quick check — planning to open a 5% canary for structured-output / function-calling on hosted API tomorrow morning. Any blockers?

kai: Heads-up: mobile SDK caches flags on startup so rollout will be sticky until next app launch. We should scope mobile separately. :eyes:

julian: Agree. Propose two scopes: 5% web-only canary + 5% mobile-devs (internal builds). Also add a compat flag so older clients get the old payload.

maria: Yup. Can we have a `structured_output_compat` flag that maps client semver to behavior? Example config I was thinking: 
```
structured_output: {
  enabled: false,
  canary: 0.05,
  audiences: ["internal-web", "mobile-devs"],
  min_client_version: "1.3.0"
}
```

sam: Telemetry reqs: emit `fncall.schema.fail` (count), `fncall.errors` (count), `structured_output.latency.p95`. Also add a daily eval job to run the golden prompt set and compare outputs.

julian: Add a regression alert that fires if schema.fail rate > 0.5% over 10m or if p95 increases by > 50ms. Ops should have an auto-disable playbook.

ops: We'll wire an automated guardrail: if `schema.fail` rate > 1% for 10m we flip `structured_output.enabled=false` and notify #incidents + oncall. Can add a softer alert at 0.5% first.

kai: SDK change: expose flag as `structuredOutput.mode` with values `legacy|compat|structured`. Default clients <1.3.0 get `legacy`. I'll draft PR and ping for CR.

maria: Nice. For rollout phases: 
- Phase 1 (internal): 5% internal traffic + mobile-devs (24h)
- Phase 2 (limited external): 20% external customers (48h)
- Phase 3: ramp to 100% over days if no regressions

maria: Also need QA checklist: run these prompt cases (edge cases): nested params, optional fields, ambiguous types. Link to doc: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/structured-output-checklist (placeholder)

sam: Will add the golden prompt suite and evaluation harness. I'll push dashboards for the metrics above.

julian: Also callout for model fallback: if runtime returns unknown structured token or schema mismatch, gateway should rewrite to `legacy` output for that request and increment `fncall.fallback_count`.

kai: Good call. That avoids client crashes. We'll also add a client-side defensive parsing helper in SDK.

maria: Ops/Dev-bot, schedule the canary deploy job for 10:00 PST tomorrow and lock the flag so it cannot be turned on globally by mistake.

dev-bot: Deploy job created: job/rollout-structured-output-1817623456 scheduled 2026-04-12T10:00:00-07:00. Watch logs: /deploys/rollout-1817623456

ops: Adding the runbook to the deploy: rollback command is `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/disable?flag=structured_output` and an automated override to pause ramp.

maria: Thanks — I'll paste a PR checklist into the thread with CR links once kai opens the SDK PR. :thumbsup:

kai: PR up shortly — CC @julian @maria for review.

julian: Reviewing after lunch. If anything pops we can abort the canary before 10:00.

maria: Perfect. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed. :partyparrot:
